purpose: Teach: ジョナサン/ジャカルタ/草津/マイアミ/ロースト/ニーチェ/のび太/ワトソン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジョナサンの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's going to read you that Jonathan picture book.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Slight lift in the voice as if sharing a small gift. Eyes soft on him. Pause before the name to let him hear it clearly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとジャカルタの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I already looked at the Jakarta book with Dad!
lines.style: Quick, bright energy—a child eager to claim his own memory. Small leap forward in his words. Proud that he's already done something good.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが草津温泉に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's taking you to Kusatsu hot springs.
lines.style: Same warm, steady tone. Eyes watching for his reaction. A promise delivered gently, as if handing something precious to a small hand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとマイアミの地図見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I already looked at the Miami map with Dad!
lines.style: Same bright urgency as before. Slightly faster—he's building a list of proof. Genuine delight in the remembering.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがローストビーフを焼いて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's going to roast beef for you.
lines.style: Same gentle cadence. Warmth in the tone. A small smile in the voice—food as love. Letting each word settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ニーチェって誰?お父さんに聞いてみるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, who's Nietzsche? I'm going to ask Dad about it.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity—the question arrives naturally, not performed. Small pause before the name, testing it in his mouth. Decision in the last sentence: he's going to do this thing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは翔くんがのび太そっくりだと思うわ
lines.en: Sho, I think you're just like Nobita.
lines.style: Wry affection underneath. A small, knowing laugh just before the words. Not quite teasing—more like she's caught him being exactly who he is, and she finds it endearing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとシャーロック・ホームズのワトソンの話したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I talked about Sherlock Holmes's Watson!
lines.style: Bright, proud conclusion. A little breathless—like he's been holding this story and finally gets to tell it. Small warmth at the end: this is a good memory to close on.
